task_description: Each record is one material-failure incident report from a plant/refinery archive (Material Consulting Services). The document may mix report prose, lab analysis, and figure captions. Extract what the report itself states; never infer beyond the text. NOTE: the failure_class option list below is a PLACEHOLDER — replace it with the empirical top-5 classes once a first extraction pass over the real archive establishes class frequencies.

fields.name: incident_number
fields.description: The incident/report reference number as printed in the report (e.g. 'INC-1234', lab report no.). Null if not printed.

fields.name: failure_class
fields.description: The primary failure type concluded by the report. Use 'other' when the concluded mechanism fits none of the listed classes.

fields.name: failure_mechanism_verbatim
fields.description: The report's own wording for the failure mechanism/mode, verbatim (e.g. 'chloride stress corrosion cracking', 'CO2 corrosion', 'sulfidation').

fields.name: material
fields.description: Material of the failed component as stated (e.g. 'carbon steel A106 Gr B', '316L SS').

fields.name: component
fields.description: The failed equipment/component (e.g. 'heat exchanger tube', '6-inch pipeline elbow').

fields.name: incident_date
fields.description: Date of the failure/incident (not the report issue date) as stated; ISO YYYY[-MM[-DD]].

fields.name: has_micrographs
fields.description: True if the report text refers to metallographic/SEM micrographs or magnifications (e.g. '500X', 'SEM image').

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One to three sentences summarizing what failed and how, in plain words drawn from the report.
